title: diagnose golden-fixture suite file (cases.json)
description: Documentation-grade schema for the per-suite cases.json files. Inputs and case names are HAND-WRITTEN; every `expected` block is MACHINE-GENERATED by scripts/gen-diagnose-fixtures.py from the Python reference engine and hand-reviewed before commit. `expected: null` marks a case whose golden output has not been frozen yet. All suites are routing-free (SPEC.md §5): modelfit/check cases always inject classification, so no fixture needs the embedding model. Catalog syncs are expected to churn modelfit/cost/check — regenerate alongside them.

target.description: The Python reference entry point the generator runs for this suite.

name.description: Unique within the suite; used as the test id in both SDKs.

description.description: What behavior this case pins (cite the SPEC section).

input.description: Suite-specific input. intake/check: {data} inline or {input_file} relative to the fixtures dir; check also takes {opts}. resolve: {model}. modelfit: {classification, resolved_model_id?, declared_model?, priorities?}. cost: run_cost keyword inputs ({canonical_text?, resolved_model_id?, declared_model?, output_tokens?, calls_per_day?, cache_ctx?, classification?, priorities?} — classification builds fit_internal via run_model_fit). hygiene: {prompt}. cli: {argv, stdin_file?, copy_from_corpus?} — run in a FRESH temp cwd (check writes a run dir), with copy_from_corpus files staged into it; expected = {stdout_golden, stderr, exit_code}, and test_diagnose_cli_parity.py additionally byte-compares the files both CLIs write.

expected.description: Machine-generated golden output. null until frozen. intake: normalize_inventory result or {error}. resolve: {model_id, method}. modelfit: the run_model_fit payload. cost: the run_cost payload. hygiene: the run_hygiene payload. check: the full findings document or {error}.
